p16.title: Discover spaced paths and dispatch a literal search per file
p16.script: find notes -type f -name '*.txt' -exec rg -H -n -F TODO '{}' ';' | sed 's/TODO/TASK/'
p16.reason: find sorts directory entries and dispatches a literal argv per matching file; spaces are not split; only content tokens are replaced.
p16.childObservation: find uses its injected aggregate executor, not guaranteed middleware child entry; no replacement handler. Verify actual child effects; no pretend context.invoke witness.
